title: Snack Attack
tagline: Catch every snack. Miss one and the lunchbox judges you.
description: Move a lunchbox beneath falling snacks while the conveyor belt changes speed every five seconds. Golden snacks add a multiplier; broccoli subtracts it.
prompt: Unique catcher browser-game design: CATCH THE ORDER. Build Snack Attack around Tap the falling snack before it hits the floor.
